name: Custom Background
author: Yapmod
description: Set a custom background image and optionally change the accent color. Panels become slightly translucent so the image shows through.

settings.label: Background Image
settings.description: Select an image to use as the app background.

settings.label: Blur Amount
settings.description: Blur the background image to reduce distraction (0–20px).

settings.label: Accent Color
settings.description: Override the primary accent color (buttons, links, highlights).

settings.label: Enable Background
settings.description: Toggle the custom background on and off.
